newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First's Morgan won't seek Maori committee chair.
newsitem.headline: NZ First's Morgan won't seek Maori committee chair.

text.p: New Zealand First MP Tukoroirangi Morgan, under fire from the opposition over his role in controversial Aotearoa Television, said on Wednesday he would not be seeking nomination for the position of chairman of parliament's Maori Affairs select committee.

"This is going to be a significant year for the Maori Affairs select committee and for Maori people as a whole, but I am wary that events which took place before I became an MP could detract from the work before the committee and cloud important Maori issues," Morgan said in a statement.
"If I chaired the committee it would not be fair to the committee's members or Maori people who the committee serves."
Morgan said he told NZ First leader Winston Peters of his decision on Tuesday and then put it to the party's caucus.
